Food Safety Inspections Uncover Violations and Seizures Across India

Food safety authorities conducted surprise inspections in multiple locations, leading to the seizure of unsafe and expired products. In Bhadrachalam, Telangana, 30 kg of unsafe products were seized. In Bengaluru, Karnataka, eight top clubs were found to have food safety violations. A separate crackdown at medical hostel canteens in Karnataka resulted in the seizure of 7 kg of rava and 8 liters of expired milk.
